intro: Everything new in beta 21, on screen, before the final release test: Lite mode, the keyboard map, the first-launch setup and the tour. Then the Workshop page as Steam will show it, the gallery, what the release test checks and the change note.

items.title: Lite: the windows in use
items.look: Left: Lite. Right: the same moment in Full.
items.what: Buttons with one bold line, filled; Filter and List or Grid in words; no Same type buttons; no marks strip on the item card; the watch in the corner.

items.title: Lite: a question with OK and Cancel
items.look: OK in your positive color, Cancel in your negative color.
items.what: The colors come from the game's Accessibility options, so each player sees their own.

items.title: Lite: a radio
items.look: Power and Mute as radio buttons; no preset keys.
items.what: The game's own radios have no presets, so Lite leaves them out.

items.title: Lite: an appliance
items.look: On and Off as radio buttons.

items.title: Lite: the dashboard
items.look: Every car gets the black Dash Elite.

items.title: Lite: the watch
items.look: A plain clock in the corner: time, date, temperature, and the game's speed as one row of choices.

items.title: Lite: ZeD setup
items.look: Style at the top of Look; Additions and Chords put away.
items.what: Picking Lite also sets ZeD's extras to the Vanilla preset.

items.title: Lite: the Mods screen
items.look: Profiles and Load order stay, as in the game's own; folders go.

items.title: The keyboard map
items.look: Every key the game uses lit; a key with two jobs in your negative color; a key picked and an action waiting for its new key.

items.title: Welcome: pick your own
items.look: Light picked: the desk and the preview change as you pick.
items.what: Shows once, the first time ZeD runs. Skip puts everything back.

items.title: Welcome: load a setup
items.what: Reads Zomboid/Lua/ZeD_setup.txt, written by Save setup here or on another machine.

description_notes: Changed from beta 20: the version in the beta line, the Gadgets bullet now names Lite mode, and the Controller bullet names the keyboard map. Pictures unchanged.
gallery_notes: No gallery changes for beta 21: the 71 pictures from beta 20 stay as they are. Lite mode, the keyboard map, the setup and the tour are not in the gallery yet; tell me if you want pictures of them added.
tests_lead: The full release test runs every script below at 4K and on the true Steam Deck screen. These are the changes since the last full run (run 11, beta 20).

tests.what: Lite mode: Style picked in ZeD setup like a player; the plain forms switch on; the Vanilla preset; Additions and Chords hidden; button colors from the game's good and bad colors; the black Dash Elite; the watch's speed row; no presets, memory key or lamp on any radio; Filter and List or Grid as words; no Same type; no marks strip; then Full back.
Lite on the main menu: no desk apps or notes; the Mods screen keeps Profiles and Load order. (A main-menu run, beside the release test.)

The keyboard map: opens from the window menu; lists every binding; lights only bound keys; a changed key works at once, is written the game's way and survives a restart; a clash in the bad color; Reset asks once. Your own key file is put back byte for byte.
The first-launch setup: opens by itself only the first time; every choice sets its option; Skip restores; Save and Load a setup. (Two main-menu launches.)
The tour: starts by itself when asked for; all seven balloons in order, each pointing at its thing; a step with nothing on screen is passed over; Stop, Done, the controller's words, A and B.

Their Simple legs set the eight old Simple switches, which Lite retired. They are being switched to the one Style switch before the run; the plain dashboard strip checks go (Lite's dash is checked in rt_lite).

tests_notes: Nothing else was removed. Not covered by a script: how the Options wheel's Style slice looks, how the radio-button rows draw, and the tour on a real controller (no controller on the test machine).
